name: Orange Park
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Orange Park, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Orange Park, FL: Hometown Holiday in the Park, Cocoa and Carols, The Nutcracker, Santa at the library and the Lakeside market.
lede: Orange Park's Christmas centers on Hometown Holiday in the Park at Clarke House Park, with Santa photos, hay rides and a lighted trail, plus Cocoa and Carols and a ballet Nutcracker nearby.
celebrates: The Town of Orange Park and the Historical Society of Orange Park host Hometown Holiday in the Park at Clarke House Park, with a shopping village, live music, tours of the Clarke House, hay rides through a decorated trail of lights and photos with Santa. Cocoa and Carols fills a field on Wells Road with student musicians, free cocoa and photos with Santa, Mrs. Claus and the Grinch. At the Thrasher-Horne Center, The Florida Ballet dances The Nutcracker. The Clay County library system brings Santa to the Orange Park Library, and the Lakeside Christmas Market adds another Santa photo stop on Blanding Boulevard.
lastyear: The Town of Orange Park's Hometown Holiday page carries photos and references from earlier editions in 2021 and 2022, which shows the event has run for several years. This year Explore Clay says Cocoa and Carols moved to a new location, the field behind bestbet on Wells Road, so that more families can gather. The Florida Ballet's Nutcracker returns to the Thrasher-Horne Center with the center's all-in ticket pricing, now starting at $38.
facts: The Clarke House at Clarke House Park, 1039 Kingsley Avenue, is the centerpiece of the town's Hometown Holiday, and the Historical Society of Orange Park co-hosts the event. The Thrasher-Horne Center, at 283 College Drive, hosts both The Nutcracker and a separate Nutcracker in a Nutshell show. Cocoa and Carols features five stages of Clay County student musicians, according to the Explore Clay listing.
trains: Orange Park's 2026 listings do not include a train ride. Hometown Holiday offers hay rides through a trail of lights, according to the town's page. For trains, families head to Jacksonville, and our Jacksonville terminal page is the closest railroad museum entry on the site. Check back with our Jacksonville guide for train and holiday light events in the city.
train_links: The closest train museum page on our site, in Jacksonville.
traditions: A town and Historical Society event with hay rides through a trail of lights and Clarke House tours.
Five stages of Clay County student musicians and free cocoa.
The Florida Ballet at the Thrasher-Horne Center.
The Orange Park Library hosts a Santa visit with photos.
A December market with local vendors and Santa.
kidfact: At Hometown Holiday in the Park, children can ride a hay ride through a decorated trail of lights and play in the snow.
faq: What is the biggest Christmas event in Orange Park?
The town lists Hometown Holiday in the Park at Clarke House Park as its holiday event, with free admission, hay rides, a shopping village and Santa photos for $20 each.
Where do we park for Hometown Holiday?
The town's page says general parking is across Kingsley Avenue at First Baptist Church of Orange Park, with limited handicap parking inside the park.
Is there a ballet near Orange Park?
Yes. The Florida Ballet performs The Nutcracker at the Thrasher-Horne Center, 283 College Drive, with a shorter listed show called Nutcracker in a Nutshell.
Where can kids meet Santa for free?
The library calendar lists Santa at the Orange Park Library, and Cocoa and Carols offers photos with Santa, Mrs. Claus and the Grinch, though neither prints a price.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Orange Park for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from December 2 (Santa Visits the Library at Orange Park Library) through December 13, with Cocoa and Carols (December 11), Hometown Holiday in the Park (December 12) and The Nutcracker at Thrasher-Horne Center (December 12 and 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Orange Park

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Orange Park
  • 1 free event: Hometown Holiday in the Park (free admission, with a $20 digital Santa photo)
  • Meet Santa: Santa Visits the Library, Cocoa and Carols, Hometown Holiday in the Park and the Lakeside Christmas Market
  • Parades and tree lightings: none in Orange Park itself; the Clay County parades are in Green Cove Springs and Fleming Island
  • Trains: none listed; Hometown Holiday offers hay rides through a trail of lights
  • Season: December 2, 2026 to December 13, 2026
